This fresh sol-medium execution, dated 2026-11-05, consumes the exact current CP-4 capacity handoff and historical focused CP-0/CP-1/legal CP-4 for Ares Capital Corporation at 2024-12-31, focusing on the 5.950% notes due July 15, 2029. Run: sol-remaining-arcc-capacity-challenge-20261105; method deploy-v-r14; pathway covenant_refinancing. This is focused consumer proof, not a full CP-6 gate, eleven-step debate, committee decision, current underwriting or whole-pathway execution. No independent agents or separate debate roles were run.

facts.label: Decision consequence
facts.text: The strongest bear pathway is portfolio marks and funded uses → weaker adjusted coverage and/or borrowing base → constrained funding before payment default. Cash-funded returns remove assets; debt-funded uses also change senior claims. Restrictions could force asset sales, repayment or equity funding. This is an analyst stress mechanism, not an observed breach, quantified shock or prediction of default.

facts.label: Decision consequence
facts.text: The strongest rebuttal is substantive: published 1.962x exceeds 1.5x; A88 reports USD635m cash and substantial conditional facilities; A276 asserts material facility compliance; January 2025 issuance demonstrates capital-market execution. This defeats an unsupported immediate-closure thesis. It does not prove that intended draws remain executable after uses, marks, equity requirements and collateral eligibility. Thus historical flexibility survives; exact usable incremental debt and RP capacity remain unresolved. No trade, size, present compliance or recovery estimate follows.

facts.label: Consumption controls
facts.text: All values are reused, not new arithmetic: current CP-4 C1–C7 records 1962/1000; 150/100; 1.962−1.5; 196.2−150; whole-percent 196−150 = 46 pp; 6732−4513 = USD2,219m; and 4513−1113−52 = USD3,348m.
